item.title: Llama 3.3 vs Mistral Large 2 — Local Model Showdown
item.description: Running open-source models locally? We benchmarked both on MMLU, HumanEval, and raw inference speed on consumer GPUs. Hardware Setup GPU: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24GB VRAM) Quantization: Q4_K_M (4-bit) Software: Ollama 0.2.0 Speed Comparison Model Prompt Speed Generation Speed Llama 3.3 120 tokens/s 45 tokens/s Mistral Large 2 140 tokens/s 52 tokens/s Winner: Mistral Large 2 (faster inference) Coding Benchmark Python Debugging Both models were given 50 broken LeetCode Medium problems.
